verdict.rationale: GitHub integration features (@gemini-cli task delegation, issue triage, PR reviews, PR/rebase automation) suggest the tool can be invoked against issues and PRs to help produce a full workflow, but there's no evidence of a single automated 'issue-to-PR' pipeline, and multiple hands-on reports describe it getting stuck in loops, failing basic edits, jumping into spaghetti code without planning, and even destructive errors—undermining reliable end-to-end PR generation.
